projects.title: Online Travel Agency (OTA) Platform
projects.description: Web-based travel booking platform enabling users to search, compare, and book flights from multiple airlines and GDS systems
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive travel booking platform integrating multiple airlines (Novo Air, US-Bangla Airlines, Jazeera Airways, AirAstra, Air Arabia, IndiGo) and Global Distribution Systems (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). Built with scalable microservices architecture to handle high-volume flight searches and bookings.

projects.title: Booking Manager Service
projects.description: Background service that automatically cancels un-ticketed bookings, saving ~$23K-$27K total across 6 OTA clients
projects.longDescription: Developed a critical background service using ASP.NET Core & Hangfire that automatically cancels un-ticketed bookings before the last ticketing time. This solution reduced ADM penalties by $4,500-$6,400 per month per OTA, achieving total savings of ~$23,000-$27,000 across 6 clients.

projects.title: Foodi CRM - Food Delivery System
projects.description: Full-stack customer relationship management system for food delivery businesses
projects.longDescription: Foodi CRM is a comprehensive customer relationship management system for food delivery businesses, enabling order tracking, restaurant management, delivery partner monitoring, and customer interaction. Built with a scalable microservices architecture focused on performance and usability.

projects.title: Recruiter.Bdjobs.com
projects.description: Hiring management platform allowing employers to manage job posting to online assessments and interviews
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive recruitment platform that allows employers to manage the entire hiring process from job posting to online assessments and interviews. Built with Angular frontend and ASP.NET Core backend, integrated with Bangladesh's largest job portal ecosystem.

projects.title: DevNote Blog-site
projects.description: A blog platform allowing users to read and write blog posts
projects.longDescription: A full-stack blog platform that allows users to read and write blog posts. Features include user authentication, rich text editing, and responsive design. Built with Angular for the frontend and ASP.NET Core for the backend API.

projects.title: Airline Supplier Integration Projects
projects.description: 8 cloud-native supplier integration projects connecting OTA platforms with major airlines and GDS systems
projects.longDescription: Developed 8 cloud-native supplier integration projects (Sabre, Travelport, Travelport NDC, Air India, Flydubai, SQ NDC, TK NDC, Indigo) to integrate supplier APIs into client OTA platforms. These integrations increased flight search feed by 27% and enabled seamless booking across multiple airline systems.
